name: Localization Analyzer
tagline: Find missing, unused, and hardcoded localization issues
description: Pure-Dart localization analysis engine that scans Dart sources and ARB files for hardcoded text, missing keys, unused keys, and duplicates — with no Flutter or DevTools UI dependencies. Frontends (CLI, DevTools) only read files and present diagnostics.

showcase.problem: Localization drift—hardcoded strings, missing keys, unused entries, and duplicates—often appears only after QA or production releases.
showcase.solution: A Pure-Dart analyzer API that frontends call with source and ARB inputs to surface diagnostics early in the development loop.

features.title: Hardcoded text detection
features.description: Flag string literals that look like UI copy, with // loc-ignore suppressions.

features.title: Missing and unused keys
features.description: Compare Dart usage against ARB definitions across locales.

features.title: Allowlist configuration
features.description: Ignore exact strings, patterns, and path substrings via AnalyzerConfig or JSON.

demo.note: Run the workspace CLI (dart run tool/scan_localization.dart). Public interactive demo not published.

showcase.architecture: Pure-Dart package with no Flutter/DevTools dependencies. Hosts (CLI, DevTools) load files and present LocalizationAnalyzer results.
showcase.installation: Use from the MBO / cmic_localization_inspector workspace: depend on packages/localization_analyzer, or run dart run tool/scan_localization.dart from the workspace root.

changelog.notes: Analyzer API with hardcoded/missing/unused/duplicate diagnostics and allowlist config.

showcase.contributing: Report false positives and locale edge cases via GitHub issues on the MBO repository.
